message: <form> is never closed: it runs to the end of the file. Add </form> where it should end.
<textarea name="message"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
<textarea/> doesn’t close the element: HTML ignores "/" on non-void elements, so <textarea> stays open and swallows everything up to the end of the file. Write <textarea></textarea>.
